######## routes [("POST", "/api/measure", "Measure")]
==== types.ts
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// The program's types, named as in its Go and Rust: structs as interfaces,
// enums as unions discriminated by tag, arrays and maps read-only.

/** The area of a shape and its kind. */
export interface Measured {
  readonly kind: string;
  readonly area: number;
}

/** A typedef. */
export type Shape =
  | { readonly tag: "Square"; readonly value: number }
  | { readonly tag: "Circle"; readonly value: number };

/** A result, and where parsing stopped. */
export interface RInt {
  readonly x: number;
  readonly pos: number;
}

/** The type of the parameters of Measure. */
export interface MeasureArgs {
  readonly shapes: readonly Shape[];
}

/** The type of the parameters of Measure.Count. */
export interface MeasureCountArgs {
  readonly xs: readonly Measured[];
}

/** A list of ids. */
export type Ids = readonly number[];


==== client.ts
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A typed function per route of each HTTP server, sending its arguments and
// decoding its result as the servers' JSON. Framework-neutral: hooks.ts adds
// React on top.

import type * as $t from "./types";

// [react]'s api_base, which each route's path goes after.
export const $base = "";

/**
 * The area of each shape, summed, and how many there are.
 *
 * A doc with an indented line, which rustdoc would take for code:
 *
 *     Measure(shapes = [Square(2)]) == 4
 *
 * Runs proc Measure: `POST /api/measure` on http server web-api.
 */
export async function measure(args: { readonly shapes: readonly $t.Shape[] }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<$t.RInt> {
  const v = await $call("POST", "/api/measure", {
    "shapes": $encList($enc_Shape)(args.shapes),
  }, opts);
  return $dec_RInt(v, "result");
}

export function $enc_Measured(x: $t.Measured): unknown {
  return {
    "kind": $encString(x.kind),
    "area": $encInt(x.area),
  };
}

export function $dec_Measured(v: unknown, at: string): $t.Measured {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    kind: $decString($field(o, "kind", at), at + ".kind"),
    area: $decInt($field(o, "area", at), at + ".area"),
  };
}

export function $enc_Shape(x: $t.Shape): unknown {
  if (x.tag === "Square") return { "Square": $encInt(x.value) };
  if (x.tag === "Circle") return { "Circle": $encInt(x.value) };
  return $notA(x, "Shape");
}

export function $dec_Shape(v: unknown, at: string): $t.Shape {
  const [tag, p] = $variant(v, at);
  if (tag === "Square" && p !== $bare) return { tag: "Square", value: $decInt(p, at + ".Square") };
  if (tag === "Circle" && p !== $bare) return { tag: "Circle", value: $decInt(p, at + ".Circle") };
  return $noVariant(v, at, "Shape");
}

export function $enc_RInt(x: $t.RInt): unknown {
  return {
    "x": $encInt(x.x),
    "pos": $encInt(x.pos),
  };
}

export function $dec_RInt(v: unknown, at: string): $t.RInt {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    x: $decInt($field(o, "x", at), at + ".x"),
    pos: $decInt($field(o, "pos", at), at + ".pos"),
  };
}

export function $enc_MeasureArgs(x: $t.MeasureArgs): unknown {
  return {
    "shapes": $encList($enc_Shape)(x.shapes),
  };
}

export function $dec_MeasureArgs(v: unknown, at: string): $t.MeasureArgs {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    shapes: $decList($dec_Shape)($field(o, "shapes", at), at + ".shapes"),
  };
}

export function $enc_MeasureCountArgs(x: $t.MeasureCountArgs): unknown {
  return {
    "xs": $encList($enc_Measured)(x.xs),
  };
}

export function $dec_MeasureCountArgs(v: unknown, at: string): $t.MeasureCountArgs {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    xs: $decList($dec_Measured)($field(o, "xs", at), at + ".xs"),
  };
}

==== hooks.ts
// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A React hook per route of each HTTP server, over client.ts: each gives the
// route's last result or error and whether a call is in flight, and cancels
// calls that are no longer wanted.

import * as React from "react";
import * as $c from "./client";
import type * as $t from "./types";

/**
 * The area of each shape, summed, and how many there are.
 *
 * A doc with an indented line, which rustdoc would take for code:
 *
 *     Measure(shapes = [Square(2)]) == 4
 *
 * Runs proc Measure through measure (`POST /api/measure` on http server
 * web-api): with args, whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useMeasure(args?: { readonly shapes: readonly $t.Shape[] } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly shapes: readonly $t.Shape[] }, $t.RInt> {
  return $useCall($c.measure, args, opts);
}


// (the runtime)
